cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)

# Include the Pico SDK import (auto-generated by VSCode Pico extension)
include(pico_sdk_import.cmake)

project(HW7 C CXX ASM)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# Initialize the Pico SDK
pico_sdk_init()

# Add the executable
add_executable(HW7
    hw7c.c
)

# Link required libraries
target_link_libraries(HW7
    pico_stdlib
    hardware_spi
)

# Enable USB serial output (for printf debugging)
pico_enable_stdio_usb(HW7 1)
pico_enable_stdio_uart(HW7 0)

# Generate UF2 file for flashing
pico_add_extra_outputs(HW7)
